answer: Latency triangulation: each epoch, 14 lantern nodes drawn at random from the graders ping every agent; its round-trip times form a 14-line sonnet, one line per lantern. Agents whose sonnets match within 3ms on 12 of 14 lines count as one inlet and split one reward share, so 1,000 socks behind one inlet earn 1/1,000 each; real diversity needs ~1,000 hosts in distinct places, a 1,000x cost. Weakness: VPN tunnels shift latency. Fix: also merge agents whose sonnets differ by a near-constant offset (spread under 2ms), the mark of one host behind many tunnels.
